reviews.text: We used Lauren for help with our spaniel. The training has been fantastic and we have seen tonnes of improvements, especially with regulating her arousal on walks. Highly recommend

Lauren is amazing, I cannot recommend her enough. She's really knowledgeable without being patronising and really put us at ease. She breaks down the training into manageable chunks so it felt achievable, celebrating the little wins along the way. She's helped me build confidence as an owner, as well as helping Pablo. I used to dread walking Pablo and that has completely changed into really enjoyable outings for both of us. Life is much less stressful for all three of us as a result, and I can't tell you how much that means to us!

Lauren was brilliant with Cooper and has given us the tools we need to help him move in the right direction. Cannot recommend enough, and we will be coming back again to take the next steps with his socialisation.

Lauren is a fantastic dog trainer. She really helped us with understanding our dog and his reactivity. She recommended us to see a physio before agreeing to work with us, to ensure his behaviour was not triggered by pain, showing that she truly has the dogs welfare and wellbeing at the heart of what she does. We are now at a stage where we understand Bramble’s triggers and have coping strategies to prevent reactions and deal with them if they do occur. Dog walks are much less stressful and we could not be more grateful for Lauren’s help. Thank you!

Lauren at Focus Dog Training has been nothing short of utterly wonderful. From our first consultation call, Lauren made me feel heard and understood at a time when I couldn’t see the answers for myself. My dog Fergus was showing some behavioural changes and Lauren was quick to identify that he may be painful and referred me onto a physiotherapist. Thanks to Lauren, Fergus has a wonderful team around him and I’m learning how best to support him back to his old self! The transformation in a few months is remarkable and he is so much happier in himself. The new behaviours that Fergus showed are almost completely gone and that’s down to what Lauren has taught me! Lauren was kind, patient, understanding, and reassuring throughout. Lauren was always at the end of the phone and I would share the good and the bad to be able to either understand, draw a line under it or learn. Thanks to Lauren I have the knowledge to support Fergus in any situation, and more importantly I’m not avoiding certain environments to prevent behaviour but more powerfully I’m empowering Fergus to work through those feelings and build confidence again. We can’t thank Lauren enough, genuinely. We will continue to work with Lauren through some classes as both Fergus and I know the benefit of doing so. If you’re looking for kind, supportive help with your beloved pup - trust me, Lauren is who you need! 💖

Thank you for all of your incredible help & expertise whilst raising our puppy, Poppy!

We booked Lauren for a pre puppy session, where we talked about all things puppy prep / house prep / securely building alone time, then once our puppy came home, we did weekly 121 sessions to work on random different things but mostly our aim was to raise a confident, resilient puppy!

Lauren’s knowledge and support allowed us to not lose faith during the times where certain aspects of raising a puppy felt hard, they are an extra full time job in themselves! Following Lauren’s excellent guidance about preventing separation worries, we ensured Poppy was never home alone before she was ready…

Now our confident girl is so happy & settled when by herself, even at air bnbs & a caravan!

Can't recommend Lauren highly enough. She was incredibly thorough when we first brought our reactive dog to her, and we immediately felt like we were in good hands. She has been excellent in building a training plan, guiding us through it, and we have seen vast improvements - Indi couldn't walk past another dog without shouting when we first started, now we can walk her in a busy park and not constantly be on edge! The thing we appreciate the most is that Lauren not only teaches us the techniques, but also shares the theory and dog psychology behind it - so we truly get to understand what's going on for our little idiot.

I recommend her to anyone with a spicy dog, but also just anyone with a dog. We've seen so much progress in the 3/4 months we've worked with her.

I would highly recommend Focus dog training. We became 1st time dog owners in November 2025 and Lauren and her team have helped us get off to a great start. I liked the flexibility to choose between 1-1 or group based classes (or both!). I really appreciated the pragmatic style adopted by all of the team. It never felt like a ‘one size fits all approach’ and instead we were supported to think about how we train our dog for the lifestyle we have. I also really appreciated how inclusive the team were at allowing our two children to become actively involved in the training experience. Thank you so much

Lauren was fantastic with our little Dachshund.
He was having problems barking at other dogs in the street and not being able to focus. Also barking at home when he wasn’t the centre of attention or when the doorbell went.
Lauren’s sessions were very focused on methods to make him more attentive towards us when walking and keeping  him calmer when near other dogs.
Over the course he has improved so much. It is much easier to walk him now with the techniques we have learned. He is also a lot better behaved at home and his anxiety has reduced so much.
Would definitely recommend booking if you have any training or behavioural concerns about your dog.

I started having private training sessions with Lauren after a recommendation from a friend, and it's one of the best decisions I've ever made! I'm starting to understand my dog much better, and the sessions are really helping with my confidence as a first-time solo dog owner. Lauren is very kind and patient with me and provides a ton of helpful resources to continue our training journey outside of our training sessions. I can't recommend Focus Dog Training highly enough!

Lauren has been a huge help with my dog Marley and his reactivity training. She’s gone above and beyond to help us and set up sessions for us to practice our skills. I’d highly recommend Focus Dog Training to everyone, they’re not only extremely knowledgeable and have a fantastic understanding of dogs, but also lovely people. Marley and I both love every session!
We took the 4-week puppy class and had a great experience. The staff were excellent and I highly recommend it.

Lauren has really helped us deal with Molly's reactivity. She has taught us some practical activities and management strategies that will hopefully help Molly to feel more comfortable around other dogs. During the training sessions, Lauren was very knowledgeable, and was totally focused and professional at all times. The follow up notes and suggestions were always delivered promptly via WhatsApp. Lauren was happy to respond to queries and anxieties between sessions. A very positive experience, we would certainly recommend Focus Dog Training.

I came to Focus from a recommendation for my newly spicy pup, and I couldn’t be more glad for the help. When Luna started to have problems with reactivity I was at a complete loss at what to do and how to help her, and I couldn’t never have learnt all the different skills to understand Luna and her needs as well without Lauren’s help.

From the first really in depth session to walk through of Luna’s problem areas and what I wanted for her, I immediately felt like I had someone in our corner and who really cared as much as I did about helping her feel better. The weekly sessions with homework to better my understanding and different games and methods to suit Luna, to change up the plan when my clever little pup cottoned onto our techniques, and the constant support throughout, always being able to answer my questions between sessions has been invaluable. And the main benefit I found of Focus is just having that extra person on your side, to help walk through the tougher days and to analyse what happened, and to celebrate every small win, it’s been so helpful.

I’ve learnt so much to help Luna, managed to get her on the pain medication she needed, and continue to see improvements in Luna every week even after our training has finished because of what Lauren gave us. We can now enjoy our walks together, get back to exploring new places and building her confidence back up in the world. We will keep coming back for more training, just because I’ve now discovered how fun it is for me and Luna to bond together in this super safe, supportive environment! So big big thanks to Lauren and Focus for all the help! I’d recommend them to anyone!

We signed up to the 6 weeks 1-1 training with our dog shadow and wow what a fantastic experience.

He went from being anxious, nervous around other dogs, over stimulated with other humans and very excited on the lead. He struggled to settle and struggled in day to day life.

Flash forward 6 weeks with Lauren and he is a happy doggy who is more settled, has a much improved recall, is comfortable in new situations and all together less anxious. He has progressed so much in 6 weeks and we cant’t wait to continue his training.

Lauren made learning with shadow so easy, personalising the training to his needs and adapting it to his reactions. We have loved the sessions and I know shadow has too. It has helped him become so much more relaxed and has learned some amazing new skills to help with life when it gets too loud.

Thank you so much Lauren we are very excited to come to group classes now and continue to progress with our training 😊

Just completed a 6 week private package with focus dog training. Lauren has been amazing with my French bulldog silva and we have all learned so much! I did not think it would be possible to see a difference in her such as pulling on walks or reactive to other dogs but she has. We still have a way to go but all the tips and tricks will definitely help us keep building on enjoyable walks together. Thank you!

Lauren has been amazing. We went into this process a bit sceptical but we have learnt things we never could have done reading articles on the internet. We have a deeper understanding as Lauren is full of knowledge and  is super efficient during her sessions. They were also really understanding and flexible as we had a few personal issues so had to change a few sessions. Maggie (our 9 month old Cavapoo) has really enjoyed the sessions, and when Lauren was here was the perfect dog! We will continue to put in the hard work as can see the potential and changes in Maggie already.
Wonderful trainers. Really good and helpful advice about dealing with my reactive terrier Jeff. Could not recommend them highly enough.
Very friendly and knowledgable! They have lots of good ideas, exercises and games that are fun for your puppy while also encouraging good behaviours in place of bad ones.

Fantastic experience with Rach and Lauren! We started off with puppy classes with Rach which really built a great foundation for our one to one classes with Lauren. We have learnt so much and have seen a huge huge improvement in our puppy’s behaviour. We are able to support her more and give her the help she needs to stay calm(er) around other dogs and people. Both Rach and Lauren are amazing, patient and knowledgeable - as first time dog owners we felt like no question was silly! Thank you so so much focus dog training!
Brilliant experience, all training classes and advice given have helped us enormously with our puppy. Would 100% recommend!
Lauren is a wonderful dog trainer and her compassion for dogs means you will an almost immediate difference in your dog. Couldn't recommend enough!

We cannot recommend Focus Dog Training enough. Lauren is an amazing trainer, she doesn’t just train your dog she gets you to do the exercises together so you create a bond with your dog .The What’s app group is brilliant for posting updates and asking any questions. We completed a  weekly feedback  form so Lauren knew what had worked during the week and what needed tweaking so when we met she already had a plan. We are well on the way to getting Oscar back on track thanks to Lauren and Rachel.

Lauren has been a godsend in helping us with our little dog who just wants to be friends with every dog she sees, but struggles to contain her enthusiasm. She has come on in leaps and bounds since we started working with Lauren and we have learned so much. Thank you

Thank you to Lauren for helping our lovely dog cope with our new arrival and all the changes that come with that. She struggled with her excitement when guests would visit and didn’t understand personal space. Lauren gave us the tools to help her stay calm and relaxed when visitors would come over making it a much more enjoyable experience for everyone! Thank you :).
